notes: §1985:VII.4.4.2 prints "READ file-name-1 NEXT RECORD INTO identifier-1" (NEXT and INTO bracketed, RECORD optional), then [AT END], then [NOT AT END], then [END-READ], written "in the sequence given in the general formats" (§1985:IV.2.1). The superset readStatement keeps NEXT, RECORD and INTO in printed order, the one conditionalPhrases rule (ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates/MayAssociate) takes each phrase once, and since kb/Work PB5158 VersionConformancePass.VisitConditionalPhrases refuses NOT AT END before AT END below 2002 through ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder (COBOL0900 conditional-phrases-any-order-2002); the 2002 phrases are refused at 85 on recognition (VisitReadDirection, VisitRecordLockPhrase, VisitReadIgnoringLock, VisitReadAdvancingOnLock, VisitRetryPhrase). Probes at --std 85 (work-rs-02/c2): accepted READ F1, RECORD, NEXT RECORD INTO W with both phrases and END-READ, NEXT INTO a group, NOT END and END without AT (run: 'A 00 AAAAA', 'B 00 BB', 'C CCCCCCC', 'E1', then 46 on each later READ with the USE procedure run); (b) refused NOT AT END before AT END (COBOL0900; accepted at --std 2002, printing 'N'), INTO before RECORD, a second AT END, an empty AT END, NEXT NEXT, no file-name, a literal after INTO, a record-name operand, KEY IS and INVALID KEY on a sequential file; (c) PREVIOUS, WITH LOCK, WITH NO LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, ADVANCING ON LOCK, RETRY: COBOL0900; (a,d,f) INTO an ODO table (moves 'AAA' at N=3), INTO VT(2:) at N=8 ('ABB'), INTO an edited item ('AA AA'), INTO TE(I) with NOT AT END ADD 1 TO I (records land in TE(1), TE(2), I=3); (e) READ after CLOSE gives 47 with neither phrase run. Witness: RECORD INTO and INTO alone, phrases in printed order, END-READ. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02-refute.json).

next.reason: §1985:VII.4.4.2 is 'READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END ...] [NOT AT END ...] [END-READ]', AT END before NOT AT END. §2023:14.9.30.2 'Format 1 (sequential)' accepts every such READ with the same meaning, the omitted NEXT given by §2023:14.9.30.3 SR8 ('If neither the NEXT phrase nor the PREVIOUS phrase is specified and ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL is specified ... the NEXT phrase is implied'); but it adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, the retry-phrase and WITH [NO] LOCK, and puts AT END and NOT AT END in choice-indicator brackets, so either order is accepted. Programs the 1985 format refuses are accepted, no refusal made an exception condition: CHANGED.
